title: Published home configuration
description: What the backoffice must publish at config/home. It is deliberately stricter than the reader: the mobile app tolerates documents that break these rules (see docs/adr/0008), so that a wrong publish degrades the home instead of breaking installed apps. Publishers validate against this schema; readers must ignore unknown fields.

schemaVersion.description: Version of this contract. A reader that supports a lower version keeps its last valid configuration.

configVersion.description: Counter increased on every publish. Informative: the reader applies the last document it receives, whatever its number.

locale.description: Not read by any app version. Present only because the design example carries it; amounts are always shown as $4,820.35.

currency.description: Not read by any app version. Present only because the design example carries it; amounts are always shown as $4,820.35.

destinations.description: Allow-list of navigation destinations. An action pointing anywhere else is dropped by the reader, which keeps at most the first 32.

segments.description: Keyed by segment id. The reader keeps at most the first 12 and skips an id longer than 32 characters.

resilience.description: Fault injection for demonstration environments. Ignored by any app build that was not made with ALLOW_FAULT_INJECTION.

latencyMs.description: Delay added to every attempt. The reader clamps it to this range.

label.description: Name shown to people. The reader falls back to the segment id when it is missing.

modules.description: In the order they are drawn. The reader keeps at most the first 24.

id.description: Unique within its segment. JSON Schema cannot express that, so the publisher must check it; the reader keeps the first module with a given id.

type.description: Key of the widget registered by a domain package. Unknown types are skipped by the reader, and so is a module whose id or type is longer than 48 characters.

props.description: Settings interpreted by the module itself, nested at most 32 levels. The schema cannot bound what is nested inside without typing every module, so the publisher also limits the size of the whole document. Any object carrying a destination must use a value from the allow-list; the reader drops the ones that do not.

features.description: Every flag must be stated. The reader treats a missing flag as off.
